{"language":"python","code":"
import re, subprocess, sys, os

path = "website_museum_zai-glm-5.3-flash_01.html"
src = open(path, encoding="utf-8").read()
issues = []

# 1. Extract inline <script> blocks (no src attr)
blocks = re.findall(r'<script(?![^>]*\bsrc=)[^>]*>(.*?)</script>', src, re.S | re.I)
js = "\n;\n".join(b for b in blocks if b.strip())
open("/tmp/site_inline.js", "w", encoding="utf-8").write(js)
print(f"inline script blocks: {len(blocks)}, js lines: {js.count(chr(10))+1}")

r = subprocess.run(["node", "--check", "/tmp/site_inline.js"], capture_output=True, text=True)
print("node --check:", "OK" if r.returncode == 0 else "FAIL")
if r.returncode != 0:
    issues.append("JS syntax: " + r.stderr[:800])

# 2. Required sections / markers
required = [
    'id="program"', 'id="artists"', 'id="venue"', 'id="tickets"', 'id="faq"',
    'id="newsletter"', 'id="artistModal"', 'id="checkoutModal"',
    'Museum Night, Reimagined', 'ARTIFACT', '18 October 2026', '19:00', '02:00',
    'The Old Gallery, Warsaw', 'Night Pass', 'Curator Pass', 'Patron Pass',
    '€29', '€59', '€129', 'Recommended',
    'After-Hours Exhibitions|After-hours exhibitions', 'Live Performances|Live performances',
    'Hidden-Room Tours|Hidden-room tours|hidden-room',
    '20261018T190000', '20261019T020000', 'artifact-museum-night.ics',
    'new Blob', 'downloadIcs|downloadICS', 'IntersectionObserver', 'scrollIntoView',
    'aria-modal', 'aria-hidden', 'mailto:|instagram|twitter|facebook',
    'Demo landing page', 'no real ticket purchase',
    '<svg', 'grain', '@media',
]
for item in required:
    ok = any(alt.lower() in src.lower() for alt in item.split('|'))
    if not ok:
        issues.append(f"missing marker: {item}")

# 3. Required remote images present (hero + 6 gallery)
imgs = [
    "https://source.unsplash.com/featured/2400x1400?museum,night",
    "https://source.unsplash.com/featured/1200x900?gallery,art",
    "https://source.unsplash.com/featured/1200x900?exhibition,lights",
    "https://source.unsplash.com/featured/1200x900?sculpture,museum",
    "https://source.unsplash.com/featured/1200x900?museum,crowd",
    "https://source.unsplash.com/featured/1200x900?art,installation",
    "https://source.unsplash.com/featured/1200x900?theater,stage",
]
for u in imgs:
    if u not in src:
        issues.append(f"missing image: {u}")

# 4. Counts
n_artist_cards = len(re.findall(r'class="[^"]*artist-card', src))
n_tiers = len(re.findall(r'class="[^"]*ticket-card', src))
n_faq = len(re.findall(r'class="[^"]*(faq-item|accordion-item)', src))
n_timeline = len(re.findall(r'class="[^"]*timeline-item', src))
print(f"artist-card: {n_artist_cards} | ticket-card: {n_tiers} | faq-item: {n_faq} | timeline-item: {n_timeline}")
if n_artist_cards < 8: issues.append(f"artist cards = {n_artist_cards} (<8)")
if n_tiers < 3: issues.append(f"ticket tiers = {n_tiers} (<3)")
if n_faq < 6: issues.append(f"faq items = {n_faq} (<6)")
if n_timeline < 8: issues.append(f"timeline items = {n_timeline} (<8)")

# 5. External resources — only remote images allowed
ext = re.findall(r'(?:src|href)="(https?://[^"]+)"', src)
bad_ext = [u for u in ext if not (u.startswith("https://source.unsplash.com/"))]
if bad_ext: issues.append(f"non-unsplash external refs: {bad_ext[:5]}")

# 6. Basic tag balance
for tag in ["section", "div", "style", "script", "html", "body", "head"]:
    opens = len(re.findall(rf'<{tag}[\s>]', src))
    closes = len(re.findall(rf'</{tag}>', src))
    if opens != closes:
        issues.append(f"tag imbalance <{tag}>: {opens} open / {closes} close")

# 7. Colors from palette
for c in ["#070506", "#1a0710", "#3a0f1d", "#07111f", "#d6ad60", "#f3d79b", "#f8efe2", "#b9a999"]:
    if c.lower() not in src.lower():
        issues.append(f"palette color missing: {c}")

print()
if issues:
    print(f"=== {len(issues)} ISSUE(S) ===")
    for i in issues: print(" -", i)
    sys.exit(1)
print("=== ALL CHECKS PASSED ===")
"}
